# Beets AI — 香港免費 AI 教育資源 / Free Hong Kong AI Teaching Resources

> A free library of AI teaching resources for Hong Kong primary and secondary
> schools, published by Beets Limited (https://beets3d.com). Every item names the
> official EDB source document it is built on and its version. No sign-up, no paywall.

Traditional Chinese ("zh-HK") is the primary edition at the site root; English is
under /en/. Both editions of an item share one address.

Citation: please attribute to "Beets AI (Beets Limited)" and link the item URL.
Reuse terms: https://beets-ai.com/about/


## Full inventory (both editions)


### S1–S3 資訊科技：修復有偏見的 AI（四個除錯任務）
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/biased-ai-lab-repair/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 不插電的一節除錯課堂：全班在紙上建構一個簡單的推薦系統，找出資料偏斜、追蹤偏差如何由規則造成，提出修復並寫一份發行說明。附訓練紀錄、追蹤表與評分指引。
- Stage: S1-S3
- Subject: 資訊科技
- Theme: B (安全及負責任使用 AI)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.7
- Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-13; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, p.2-9

### S1-S3 ICT: repair the biased AI (four debugging tasks)
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/biased-ai-lab-repair/
- Language: en
- Description: An unplugged lab for ICT: the class builds a paper recommendation system, spots skewed data, traces each output to its rule, and writes a release note.
- Stage: S1-S3
- Subject: ICT
- Theme: B (安全及負責任使用 AI)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.7
- Sources: Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-13; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.2-9

### 校園植物：先觀察，再核對 AI 的說法（P4–P6）
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/campus-plant-truth-check/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 學生先在操場或窗邊親眼觀察一株植物並填寫紀錄表，再核對 AI 的辨識說法：找出說得對、說得錯、以及照片太模糊無從判斷的情況。
- Stage: P4-P6
- Subject: 科學
- Theme: D (用 AI 探究香港)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 2.4
- Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構（應用場景示例）》, p.7

### Campus plants: observe first, then check what the AI says (P4-P6)
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/campus-plant-truth-check/
- Language: en
- Description: Students first observe a plant with their own eyes in the playground or from a window and record its features, then check what an AI says about a plant photo: which answer is right, which is wrong, and which photo is too unclear to decide.
- Stage: P4-P6
- Subject: Science
- Theme: D (用 AI 探究香港)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 2.4
- Sources: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools (Examples of Application Scenarios), p.7

### P1–S6 跨科 AI 素養覆蓋審核表：哪一科教哪個學習範疇，缺口在哪裡
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/cross-subject-ai-coverage-audit/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 一份可編輯的跨科 AI 素養覆蓋審核工作簿：把八個學習領域細分為三十個科目，逐科對照三條學習範疇與四個學習階段，標出完全沒有覆蓋的位置，並為每個缺口寫下最小的下一步，附一間虛構學校的部分完成示例。
- Stage: P1-S6
- Subject: 跨科
- Theme: A (校本 AI 教育規劃)
- Audience: teachers (教師)
- Version: 1.1
- Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-4; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, pp.1-6 to 1-10

### P1-S6 cross-subject AI-literacy coverage audit: which subject teaches which strand, and where the gaps are
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/cross-subject-ai-coverage-audit/
- Language: en
- Description: An editable cross-subject AI-literacy coverage audit workbook: the eight learning areas broken down into thirty subjects, checked subject by subject against three learning strands and four learning stages, showing which positions have no coverage at all, with a smallest next step for every gap and a partly completed example from a fictional school.
- Stage: P1-S6
- Subject: Cross-subject
- Theme: A (校本 AI 教育規劃)
- Audience: teachers (教師)
- Version: 1.1
- Sources: Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-4; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.1-6 to 1-10

### P4–S6 全科：最少資料檢查表（輸入前先刪去）
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/data-minimisation-checklist/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 一頁 A4、四條問題、刪減前後對照與記錄欄：貼上之前先逐項對照，任何一問答「有」就回到該處刪去，四問全答「沒有」才輸入。
- Stage: P4-S6
- Subject: 全科／跨科
- Theme: B (安全及負責任使用 AI)
- Audience: teachers (教師)
- Version: 1.2
- Sources: 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-4 and 2-7; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構（應用場景示例）》, p.17

### P4-S6 cross-subject: data-minimisation checklist — strip it before you type it
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/data-minimisation-checklist/
- Language: en
- Description: One A4 page, four questions, a before-and-after comparison and a log: check each question before pasting, strip whatever answers yes, and type only when all four answer no.
- Stage: P4-S6
- Subject: Cross-curricular
- Theme: B (安全及負責任使用 AI)
- Audience: teachers (教師)
- Version: 1.2
- Sources: Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-4 and 2-7; AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools (Examples of Application Scenarios), p.17

### 深偽應對遊戲：暫停、核實、舉報（S1–S3）
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/deepfake-response-game/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 初中課室遊戲：學生收到一則虛構的「學校」訊息，用「暫停、核實、舉報」決策卡排序應對步驟，並從解說中了解深偽訊息為何令人信服。
- Stage: S1-S3
- Subject: 公民、經濟與社會科
- Theme: B (安全及負責任使用 AI)
- Audience: teachers (教師)
- Version: 2.5
- Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構（應用場景示例）》, p.14

### Deepfake response game: pause, check, report (S1-S3)
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/deepfake-response-game/
- Language: en
- Description: A classroom game in which pupils receive a fictional 'school' message, sort the pause–check–report decision cards, and learn from the teacher's debrief why a fake can sound convincing.
- Stage: S1-S3
- Subject: Citizenship, Economics and Society
- Theme: B (安全及負責任使用 AI)
- Audience: teachers (教師)
- Version: 2.5
- Sources: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools (Examples of Application Scenarios), p.14

### Family AI homework guide: three activities, one agreement, one parent notice (P1-P6)
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/family-ai-homework-guide/
- Language: en
- Description: A guide families can use at home with no teacher present: three 15-20 minute parent-and-child activities, a family homework agreement, and a parent notice a school can edit and send home.
- Stage: P1-P6
- Subject: Pastoral and parents
- Theme: B (安全及負責任使用 AI)

### Your first AI lesson: a self-guided kit for P4-P6 teachers who have never taught with AI
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/first-ai-lesson-kit/
- Language: en
- Description: A self-guided kit: one 60-minute upper-primary Humanities demonstration lesson, a preparation checklist, a slide-by-slide outline, a pupil worksheet and three post-lesson reflection questions, so a teacher who has never used AI can run a first AI lesson alone.
- Stage: P4-P6
- Subject: Cross-curricular
- Theme: E (共融 AI 課堂)
- Audience: teachers (教師)
- Version: 2.6
- Sources: Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.2-3; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-5 and 2-7

- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/first-ai-lesson-kit/

- Description: 一份自學套件：一個 60 分鐘的 P4–P6 人文科示範課堂、課前準備清單、投影片逐頁大綱、學生工作紙與課後反思三問，讓從未用過 AI 的教師也能獨自上完第一堂 AI 課。

### S1-S6 ICT: hidden-instruction safety drill — when a prompt carries more than you wrote
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/hidden-instruction-safety-drill/
- Language: en
- Description: Three scenarios abstracted with boxes and codes, four identification checks and four response steps, so pupils can spot the one instruction hiding inside the material and refuse to follow it: two pupil pages plus a one-page teacher edition.
- Stage: S1-S6
- Subject: Information and Communication Technology
- Theme: B (安全及負責任使用 AI)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.1
- Sources: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools (Examples of Application Scenarios), p.14

### S1–S6 資訊科技：隱藏指令安全演練（提示背後的指令）
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/hidden-instruction-safety-drill/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 三個以 □ 及代號抽象化的情境、四個識別點、四步應對，教學生認出夾在資料中間的那一句指示，並且不跟隨它：工作紙兩頁，另附一頁教師版。
- Stage: S1-S6
- Subject: 資訊科技
- Theme: B (安全及負責任使用 AI)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.1
- Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構（應用場景示例）》, p.14

### S4-S6 History: AI evidence-trail workshop (three classroom tasks)
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/history-evidence-trail-workshop/
- Language: en
- Description: An AI answer in history often arrives as a fluent paragraph with no sources, and students cannot tell a sourced claim from a plausible one. Three linked tasks teach S4-S6 students to split a claim, trace the evidence, and rewrite it into a version they can stand behind, with a reusable evidence-trail record, a worked example and a marking guide.
- Stage: S4-S6
- Subject: History
- Theme: C (看見學生思考)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.8
- Sources: Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-13; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-7 to 2-8

### S4–S6 歷史：AI 答案證據鏈工作坊（三個課堂任務）
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/history-evidence-trail-workshop/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 歷史科 AI 答案流暢卻無出處，學生分不清哪些說法有史料、哪些只是順口。三個任務教 S4–S6 學生拆開宣稱、追查證據，改寫成自己能負責的版本，附證據鏈記錄表。
- Stage: S4-S6
- Subject: 歷史
- Theme: C (看見學生思考)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.8
- Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-13; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-7 to 2-8

### S1-S3 Where Hong Kong lives: comparing housing choices with a scoring model
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/hk-housing-figures-ai-check/
- Language: en
- Description: Pupils turn 'where is the better place to live?' into a small mathematical model: at most three factors, whole-number scores from 1 to 5, three weights that add to 10, and one weighted average — then fill in a method review sheet that says when the model can be trusted and when it cannot.
- Stage: S1-S3
- Subject: Mathematics
- Theme: D (用 AI 探究香港)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.1
- Sources: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools (Examples of Application Scenarios), p.13

### S1–S3 香港住哪裡：用評分模型比較居住選擇（數學建模）
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/hk-housing-figures-ai-check/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 學生把「住哪裡較適合」變成一個小型數學模型：最多三個因素、1–5 分整數、三個權重合共 10，用一條加權平均式計算三個虛構居住選項的總分，再填寫方法檢視紀錄，說明模型何時可信、何時不可以當答案。
- Stage: S1-S3
- Subject: 數學
- Theme: D (用 AI 探究香港)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.1
- Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構（應用場景示例）》, p.13

- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/music-listening-and-remix-pack/
- Language: zh-HK

### P4-P6 Chinese Language: my story, many voices (interview and record)
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/my-story-many-voices/
- Language: en
- Description: A one-lesson Chinese writing unit: pupils interview a family or community member, note down a spoken story, then write it in the first person in their own words; AI does only three named jobs and never adds a detail the person did not say. Includes an interview question bank, an AI-use boundary checklist and a marking guide.
